Commentary.Commentary: We are inching closer and closer to the Super 12s of the T20 World Cup 2022. It is now time a game between India and New Zealand. This will also be the final warm-up match for these two sides. The Kiwis seem to be in a spot of bother after a dismal outing against the Proteas. Kiwis got bowled out for just 98 and need to find some quick solutions regarding their batting concerns. They do have solid depth on offer, and would certainly back their players to perform when it matters the most. India, on the other hand, have been able to get through their batting dilemma, although recently a few questions have been raised regarding their death bowling. It gets more complicated with Jasprit Bumrah being ruled out of the setpiece event. Although, Mohammad Shami is back into the side as a light at the end of the tunnel. Shami bowled only a single over in the previous warm-up match but that proved to be enough to shut his critics. India will be hoping to utilize this final warm-up match to their benefit and take the momentum in the main event. New Zealand batters surely need to pull their socks up against a solid Indian side. Which team will get over the line? We shall find out together.
